pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at the image itself. It was readable. It has 4 panels with no numbers or guide lines: a top row of two panels (wide on the left, narrower on the right), then two full-width tiers. Before looking at the image I read only the request JSON. I did not read the source text, script, workflow, storyboard, reading-flow files or earlier responses.
pages.observation: Natural reading order: (1) top-left, the man in the green shirt waves as he comes in the door: 'Good morning! I'd like to see the doctor.' (2) top-right, the receptionist in the blue kurta with a braid: 'Of course. May I register your details for today's appointment?' (3) middle tier, the man smiles with his eyes closed: 'Yes, please.' while she types. (4) bottom tier, the receptionist gestures toward the seats: 'You're all set, Ravi. Please have a seat.' The order is clear and nothing tempted me to skip or jump ahead. Tails: P1 the tail runs right from the top-left balloon to the man's face and clearly reaches him, not the receptionist on the left. P2 the tail drops to the top of the receptionist's head and clearly marks her. P3 the tail reaches the man's ear and cheek. P4 the tail reaches the receptionist's face on the right. Coverage: no balloon covers a face, hand or the phone. In P2 the balloon's bottom edge and tail tip come close to the receptionist's hair but stop above her face. In P1 the tail passes near the man's raised hand without covering it. Minor issues: (a) Phone continuity. In P1 a blue phone lies on the receptionist's desk by her keyboard. In P2 the man holds a blue phone. In P3 a blue phone lies on the counter in front of him. Whose phone it is and how it moves between hands and desk is unclear. Please check against the prop plan (who owns it, before, current, after, heldBy). (b) The receptionist is on the left in P1 and on the right in P2–P4, and the man is reduced to a cropped back view in P2. The reverse angle still reads, but it is a noticeable switch. (c) The name 'Ravi' is used without the man ever saying it on this page. Registering his details (P2–P3) makes this plausible but it is never shown. Not blocking.
